paired_case: Valid purpose versus hold label, empty/duplicate areas, own-side or invalid target
pass_criterion: Only the typed bounded detention purpose validates; regional legacy remains exact.

paired_case: Two fresh same-post letters and a repeated copy
pass_criterion: Distinct authored letters dispatch once each; copies add no row credit; one field goal per post per morning.

paired_case: Identical truth with exact order delivered, withheld, relay-only or wrong person
pass_criterion: Only actual addressee receipt can enact this goal; sending/relay sight is insufficient.

paired_case: New revision received/refused/lost; old revision arrives afterward; unrelated bypass
pass_criterion: Replace only through receipt/compliance; obsolete content cannot revive; ordinary chain/bypass resolver remains.

paired_case: Root mandate enacted versus missing, refused, expired, departed holder or successor
pass_criterion: Only live holder-bound in-scope authority offers and executes a choice; old grant does not pass to successor.

paired_case: Child widens action area, target actions, movement or ceiling; two siblings allocate same men
pass_criterion: Intersection and exclusive allocation checks reject escalation/double spending at selection and execution.

paired_case: Same report arrives today versus yesterday; hidden enemy correspondence changes
pass_criterion: New arrival affects next morning menu; hidden letters do not change the actor's menu.

paired_case: Attributed opposing-command report versus anonymous screen, absent or stale association
pass_criterion: Only supported target association qualifies; unknown identity/location yields typed blocker, not enemy absence.

paired_case: Same commander with attack feasible/infeasible and a feasible demonstration
pass_criterion: Explained candidates retain the detention duty; outmatched does not switch to inactive hold.

paired_case: Known available force versus unknown strength, no stores, no route or unavailable support
pass_criterion: Every failed gate is retained; no numeric split from unknown; zero executable activity when blocked.

paired_case: Plain willing demonstration versus course objection, information question and proposal
pass_criterion: Response kinds remain separate; proposal needs received acceptance; no U33 credit for generic question.

paired_case: Approved activity versus unapproved choice, elapsed date, task ordered or stage label only
pass_criterion: Only actual available allocated force executing the task records demonstration activity.

paired_case: Same real activity observed versus unwatched, filtered, delayed or lost report
pass_criterion: Opponent choices change only with delivered observation; no remote goal/mission or hidden-intention leak.

paired_case: Same pressure report; enemy elects to stay, attack, depart or leave a screen
pass_criterion: No pin effect; all legal responses remain; screen is not the main command; detention can fail.

paired_case: False or stale success/departure report versus actual movement trace
pass_criterion: Belief and attributed report can differ from actual outcome; neither report certifies performance.

paired_case: Episode completes while duty continues; deadline passes; received release/expiry/loss
pass_criterion: No objective_reached or calendar success; task closure retains duty; termination records cause, overdue remains visible.

paired_case: Blocked route, parent moved, combat losses/capture and duplicate rejoin
pass_criterion: Normal recovery/terminal outcomes conserve lots/stores/allocations; no teleport or repeated rejoin.

paired_case: Same-region activity versus a route between distinct regions, with enemy contact
pass_criterion: No invented subregion or combat immunity; actual battle stays battle; no label-only demonstration.

paired_case: Issue, receipt, reply, executed pressure, retention/departure and causal reaction
pass_criterion: Publish each separately; no endpoint-only retention or unrecorded cause; unknown components remain unknown.

paired_case: U33 challenge and separate U34 actual deferral; duplicate replies and successful pressure alone
pass_criterion: Same actor/role/matter; one act per row; no substitution, declared-compliance credit or invented covert intent.

paired_case: Seat view and normal reports versus offline diagnostic joined with truth
pass_criterion: Only diagnostic may expose actual movement/hidden delay; player receives own attributed papers through seat-api.

paired_case: Each added record and every transition; paused/recovering/pruned episode
pass_criterion: Single writer, immutable class and FOUNDATION row; no duplicate troops/authority/receipt truth or replayed closed task.

paired_case: Replay, save/resume, pruning and insertion of unrelated letter
pass_criterion: Exact hashes/choices/correlations; strict order, integers and identity-based streams; no extra resend or fresh seat call.

paired_case: Old saves/logs and unopted-in regional goals
pass_criterion: Empty new collections; legacy meaning or explicit fresh-run requirement; never invented missions/receipts/grants/activity.
